declarations.name: AuiCalendar
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI Calendar: `<aui-calendar>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor; `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. 'range': the first pick sets an anchor, the second completes the range (in either order); value is not used.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Selected inclusive range in range mode (start <= end).

inputs.name: minDays
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: minimum range length in days, counting the first and last day (integer 1-100000); shorter ends are disabled while the anchor is pending.

inputs.name: maxDays
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: maximum range length in days, counting the first and last day (integer 1-100000); longer ends are disabled while the anchor is pending.

inputs.name: visibleMonths
inputs.description: Since 0.3.0. Consecutive months shown side by side (integer 1-3). Outside days are never shown with more than one month.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound; earlier days are disabled and focus never moves before it.

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Inclusive upper bound.

inputs.name: isDateDisabled
inputs.description: Disable individual days (focusable, not selectable).

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

inputs.name: disableNonWorking
inputs.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

inputs.name: focusedDate
inputs.description: Initially focused day and visible month. Default: value, else the range start, else today (clamped to min/max).

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: ISO weekday of the first column (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Grid accessible name. Default: the visible month-year heading (aria-labelledby). With several months each grid is named '{label}, {month}'.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Advanced: fixed 'today' instead of the current date in timezone (tests, server rendering).

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides; mirrored in RTL.

inputs.name: showOutsideDays
inputs.description: Show days of the adjacent months in the first and last week (one visible month only).

inputs.name: showWeekNumbers
inputs.description: Show ISO 8601 week numbers as row headers.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Heading, weekday names, day numbers, cell names, and first day of week.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Zone used only to determine today.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Grid direction and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight mirroring.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: Single mode: the user selected a day (click, Enter, or Space), including re-selecting the current day. Range mode: the user picked the last day; range is the completed range (the first pick emits nothing).

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: The user changed the visible months (keyboard, month buttons, or an outside day); month is the first visible month.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Since 0.3.0. Range mode: programmatic range (no events); a pending anchor is discarded and the first day becomes the focused day.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Show the month of date (scrolling the visible months as needed) and make it the focused day (no events).

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Move DOM focus to the focused day.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Date Picker Dialog grid: table role=grid whose day cells (td) are the focusable gridcells with a roving tabindex. Since 0.3.0: one grid per visible month with a single roving tab stop across all grids, and range selection (aria-multiselectable grids).

limitations: A range may include disabled days: only the first and last day are checked; minDays and maxDays count both days.
At most three visible months; outside days are never shown with more than one month.
'Today' is computed on render; a calendar left open across midnight updates on the next navigation or configuration change.
Week numbers are ISO 8601, taken from the Monday of each row, whatever the first day of week.
